title: SKE Bar Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pod
description: Created for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit, this flavour delivers a tangy, layered berry experience with a satisfying sweet-sour twist. Juicy Blueberry lays the base while zesty Raspberry adds an edge of tartness that keeps things fresh and vibrant. Each pod includes 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt and uses mesh coil tech for a smooth and consistent MTL vape. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
